cases.name: X-Portkey-Key
cases.note: a provider's own auth header name, value not a stored key

cases.name: x-echo
cases.note: an unknown header whose value carries a stored key
a query value carrying a stored key under an ordinary name
a 401 body that echoes the key
the Brave key in a tool result, twice
text with no key is unchanged

vectors.rule: On the copy path a credential keeps its scheme and its last four characters: "Bearer ••••…wxyz"; a secret under 8 characters is "••••". A header is a credential when its name is authorization, x-subscription-token, x-api-key or api-key, when its name is a provider's configured auth header name, or when its value contains a stored key. A URL query value is masked when its name is credential-shaped or it contains a stored key. All copied text has every stored key (8+ characters, longest first) replaced by its mask.
